dogecoin.text:
Dogecoin crashed as Elon Musk called it "Hustle" on SNL.
#cryptocurrency #DogeSNL

Elon is running a poll asking people about their opinion on Should Tesla accept Dogecoin?
His appearance on SNL & calling Doge "Hustle" lead to fall in prices of Dogecoin. 
Further SpaceX accepting Dogecoin for it's satellite & now Tesla. Will Dogecoin go up?
#dogecoin #Crypto
